subject: Intro: Rosalind Patel (Sr ML Infra) — availability windows from agency
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@crestlinetalent.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: kate.miller@stratusai.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate intro — Rosalind Patel (Sr ML Infra) + availability

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for taking a look. I’m Sofia at Crestline Talent; I’m representing Rosalind Patel (resume attached). Rosalind is a senior ML infrastructure engineer with heavy LLM-serving experience (GPUs + orchestration). StratusAI asked us to surface strong infra candidates and Rosalind agreed to talk to your team.

Quick context:
- Rosalind is currently at a mid-stage startup working on inference runtime optimizations.
- Strong on batching, KV-cache ops, and latency profiling for production LLMs.

Rosalind is available for first-round screens next week during these windows (all PST):
- Tue 2027-04-06: 9:30–11:30am
- Wed 2027-04-07: 1:00–4:00pm
- Thu 2027-04-08: 8:30–10:30am

I attached her resume and a one-click availability calendar file. Can you let me know which slot works for your panel? If it helps, Kate (hiring manager) is CC’d — happy to coordinate around her availability too.

Attachments: Rosalind_Patel_Resume.pdf, Rosalind_availability-window.ics

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Senior Recruiter | Crestline Talent
sofia@crestlinetalent.com
(415) 555-0187
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@crestlinetalent.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kate.miller@stratusai.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate intro — Rosalind Patel (Sr ML Infra) + availability

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the intro and the resume.

Quick answers and asks for the panel:
- We can do a 45–60 minute video screen focusing on system design + inference tradeoffs. Typical panel: one infra engineer + hiring manager + a senior systems engineer (we'll cover kernel/ops questions).
- Candidate slot we prefer: Tue 2027-04-06 at 10:00am PST (45 min). If that’s still open for Rosalind, please confirm and I’ll lock the calendar.

Marissa, Jonas — looping you both to confirm you can cover 10:00–10:45 on Tue (I’ll add a short intake doc to the invite). Jonas: can you lead system-design? Marissa: can you handle panel logistics and send the feedback rubric?

I attached a short panel intake template to capture focus areas and interview goals — please fill and return; I'll push to the invite.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Recruiting Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
[Attachment: panel-intake-template.tsv]
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@crestlinetalent.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: kate.miller@stratusai.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate intro — Rosalind Patel (Sr ML Infra) + availability

Perfect — Tue 2027-04-06 at 10:00am PST works for Rosalind. I’ve attached the candidate’s preferred Zoom link in the calendar file; Rosalind asked for a primarily systems/design focus (no live coding). She also prefers feedback within 48 hours if possible.

Notes for the panel:
- Strengths: model serving latency work, ops automation, quantized inference experience.
- Areas to probe: cross-GPU KV-cache strategies, tradeoffs of batching vs. single-request latency, and experience with on-prem/private deployments.

I’ll send the formal calendar invite once you push the intake and invite — please let me know if the panel wants any prep materials from Rosalind (whitepapers, artifacts).

Sofia
[Attachment: Rosalind_availability-window.ics (calendar invite stub)]
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate intro — Rosalind Patel (Sr ML Infra) + availability

Lauren / Marissa — I’m good for Tue 10:00–10:45 and happy to lead the system-design portion.

I skimmed the resume — looks like good overlap with our current infra gaps. Would recommend we prioritize:
- KV cache eviction strategy under long-tail traffic
- How she reasons about model quantization tradeoffs for throughput vs. accuracy

I’ll prep a 20-min design prompt and a couple follow-ups. If you want, I can share a short doc for the panel (5 bullets) before the interview.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
